newsitem.title: UK: Dixons shares rise after agency cross.
newsitem.headline: Dixons shares rise after agency cross.

text.p: Shares in Dixons Group Plc shot higher on Wednesday after a large "agency cross" trade, where a broker matched a buy and sell order between two clients, at 600p late yesterday, dealers said.
The stock was quoted up 27p to 598 by 0735 GMT.
Dealers said they were unaware of the identity of the broker or the clients involved but said the trade involved a block of three million shares.
Dixons shares have rallied sharply since its results on July 9 which came in at the top end of expectations.

Dealers noted that the electrical retailer was expected to benefit from continued strength in consumer spending, highlighted on Tuesday by figures for consumer credit in June which showed an increase to a record 1.28 billion stg on the month.
